summary: Opened and settled a source-only question on leadership transfer across authority changes: the node layer consumes a queued target exactly once, the raft layer installs it only in leader state and clears it in reset() on every state transition (plus an election-timeout abort and target-removal abort), so no stale TimeoutNow can come from a deposed leader. Requests issued on candidate/observer/witness are silently ignored, which the documented best-effort contract covers. Recorded two knowledge entries and an explained, refuted interpretation; noted the residual consequences (dropped proposals during transfer, check-quorum postponement up to one election timeout). No execution requested.
